versioning.scheme: The REST API is versioned by path and is currently v1 (https://api.openai.com/v1/...); responses carry an openai-version header (currently 2020-10-01). OpenAI avoids breaking changes within a major API version; adding resources, optional parameters, response properties and streaming event types counts as backwards compatible. Models are versioned separately as families with aliases and dated snapshots (e.g. gpt-5 | gpt-5-2025-08-07); pin a snapshot for stable behaviour. Breaking change mostly arrives as model and endpoint deprecations with a shutdown date (at least 6 months' notice for generally available models, 3 months for specialized variants, possibly 2 weeks for preview models). First-party client libraries follow semantic versioning.

source.quote: OpenAI provides stability to API users by avoiding breaking changes in major API versions whenever reasonably possible.
